response.sql: WITH qualifying AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN qualifying q ON l.ID = q.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_pt_averages, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_of_tat_diff_averages FROM per_patient;
